doc: Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 (eIDAS), as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183
title: Requirements for qualified electronic time stamps
summary: A qualified electronic time stamp binds the date and time to data in a way that reasonably precludes an undetectable change of the data, rests on an accurate time source linked to Coordinated Universal Time, and is signed with an advanced electronic signature or sealed with an advanced electronic seal of the qualified trust service provider, or by an equivalent method. Implementing acts may name standards whose use is presumed to meet these requirements.
